text:
Sasha: Quick follow-up from the sampling RFC — proposing a compact sampling window for traces to reduce storage/cost spike during bursts. idea: per-tenant 'micro' window 1s for hot paths + 10s 'cohort' window for headroom.
Jamie: Want concrete tradeoffs. cost down vs query shape complexity, right?
Sasha: yup. micro windows reduce ingested spans by ~60% on p95 traffic, but increase false negatives for very short traces.
Renee: How does this interact with late enrichment? if we sample at micro window we might lose billing keys before join.
Alex: We could buffer keys in gateway for up to 10s and attach them at enrichment stage — memory cost but keeps attribution.
Sasha: Proposed config snippet:
```
sampling:
  micro_window_ms: 1000
  cohort_window_ms: 10000
  buffer_retention_ms: 10000
  fallback_policy: late-billing-lookup
```
Jamie: fallback-policy detail matters. late-billing-lookup will require a cheap lookup table; is that viable at scale?
Alex: We can run a bloom-filter style cache + async backfill for missed keys. small mem, occasional false positives (ok for cost)
Renee: Concern: queryability — compact windows will make trace reconstruction across windows harder for debugging.
Sasha: Agree. Ops needs a 'debug sample' passthrough that keeps 100% for flagged tenants or traced requests. add flag `keep_debug=true`.
Jamie: Also need clear metrics: sampled_rate_by_tenant, missed_billing_lookups, buffer_evictions
Sasha: I'll add those to the RFC follow-up doc and open a short spike to prototype buffer size vs latency. @Alex can you own the spike?
Alex: Happy to. I'll spin up a small gateway prototype and report numbers by EOW. :thumbsup:
infra-bot: Deployment note — canary for sampling changes should target test cluster first, use `canary/obs-sampling` route.
Renee: OK — if prototype shows high mem, we fallback to cohort-only windows and rely on late-billing-lookup. :thinking_face:
Sasha: Thanks all. I'll paste the updated config and metrics checklist in the RFC thread.
Jamie: SG, capture follow-ups as GH issues and tag `obs/sampling`.
Alex: I'll post a short perf log with memory/latency curves from the spike.
Sasha: End-to-end checklist: prototype -> metrics -> canary -> roll. keeping small degradations visible.
